item.title: East Baton Rouge DA issues statement on rape case involving 94-year-old woman
item.description: East Baton Rouge District Attorney Hillar Moore issued a statement on Monday addressing a case involving the rape of a 94-year-old woman in Baton Rouge.

item.title: Louisiana DOC confirms inmate death at Elayn Hunt Correctional Center
item.description: The Louisiana Department of Public Safety and Corrections confirmed that another inmate has died at the Elayn Hunt Correctional Center.

item.title: Baton Rouge Community College fundraiser features Cupid, Honky Tonk Chicks
item.description: National recording artist Cupid is headlining the Drip, Sip, & Jam spring fundraiser, which is set to take place on Thursday, March 12, inside BRCC's Bonne Santé Wellness Center. The fundraiser will support athletics at the institution.

item.title: Brookshire Grocery Company named top workplace for women in the U.S.
item.description: Brookshire Grocery Company named to Newsweek's 2026 list of America's Greatest Workplaces for Women, recognized for pay equity and leadership opportunities.

item.title: Special election for vacant Louisiana House District 69 seat: What voters need to know
item.description: Voters head to the polls Saturday to cast their vote for a new Louisiana House District 69 representative in a special primary election.

item.title: Lockdown at U.S. Air Force Base in Louisiana, shelter-in-place reported, officials respond
item.description: Barksdale Air Force Base in Louisiana issued a shelter-in-place order after an early morning security concern.

item.title: 60 people arrested, 70 roosters seized in St. Landry Parish cockfight raid
item.description: John Eddie Lachapelle, 36, of Opelousas, whom officials described as "the property owner and principal organizer of the cockfight event," is charged with cockfighting, possession of Schedule II drugs and illegal carrying of weapons in the presence of crime or drugs.

item.title: Jury selection begins for Melanie Curtin in Livingston Parish rape case
item.description: Jury selection began on Monday afternoon for the new trial of a woman accused in a Livingston Parish rape case.

item.title: Report: New Orleans Saints add depth at tight end signing Noah Fant
item.description: The New Orleans Saints are adding a depth piece at tight end during free agency. The Saints agreed to terms Monday with former Cincinnati Bengals tight end Noah Fant, according to multiple reports.
